topics.topic: Whether named project access-management revocations are exempt from INV-001's full guard sequence
questions: Does current INV-001 exclude the expressly named operations, or must those operations execute the full guard sequence?
Are project-scoped access-management revocations exceptions to INV-001, or must they execute the complete guard sequence?

quotes: - INV-001: every project-scoped operation passes the guard sequence: valid session, active principal, project access, required capability, Registry lifecycle policy; first failure wins

- revoking a viewer grant, a staff assignment or a producer grant is access
  management: it requires a valid administrator session, an active
  principal and `portal.access.manage`, and consults neither project access
  nor the Registry, so it succeeds for an archived project and during a
  Registry outage (R0-24);
judgement.why: The newly authoritative Formal invariant requires the complete guard for every project-scoped operation, while the normative exception removes project-access and Registry checks from the named revocations.
